home.heritageTitle: More than 150 years of lubrication technology
home.heritageText: Divinol is a brand of Zeller+Gmelin GmbH & Co. KG — one of Germany's oldest manufacturers, listed among the “TOP 100” most innovative German companies. Production is ISO 9001 certified, and the products are trusted by car makers, railways and industrial companies around the world.
